title: The Storm
instructions: Sing the first line of the song, unaccompanied, at a steady pace.
words: The tempest rages wild and high,

content.source: Notes and words of the first line taken from the edition: C. M. Cady, Pub. 1878, in the Mutopia Project's Public Domain transcription (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=607), squillo-lab E-004 round 3. The edition gives no metronome mark: the tempo is the transcription's MIDI default.
